New defect surfaced: SN-66-FE018 (P2) — Dual-status model not in spec

The Workforce roster renders two independent status dimensions: an Employment Status column (Active / OnLeave / Terminated / Resigned) AND an Invite Status column (PendingInvite / Invited / InviteExpired / InviteCancelled). Spec §6.5.1.6 + §7.1 define these as a single mutually-exclusive enum. GeloQATest is simultaneously Active and Invited; the stat tiles count only employment status, so the “Invited” tile shows 0 despite the row clearly displaying an Invited badge. Schema documentation requires major reconciliation — same class of issue as the Probation Status/Type collision documented in spec-vs-impl-alignment.md.

Spec deviations also observed (low-severity): (1) Invite is a full-page wizard, not the modal #inviteModal per spec §9.1.1. (2) Started column label reads “Expires in about 1 hour” instead of the spec’s “Expires in {N}h · Resend soon” format. (3) SPA /workforce route rendered blank on first hard reload — recovered after clicking sidebar Workforce link.

#6SN-66-FE006RETEST 2026-05-28: FIXED — Done (SNOPS-31) P1

Sort by Employee column completely broken (FE/BE contract mismatch)

FE click handler on the Employee column sends API request with sort=name&sortDir=asc. BE responds HTTP 400 with explicit message:
"'name' is not a known sort key. Allowed: hireDate, firstName, lastName, dateCreated, dateModified."
FE does not surface the error — instead silently shows an empty table with NO empty-state message.

Affected Test Cases

  • TC-016 — primary
  • TC-075 — name-sort URL persistence cannot be tested (sort itself broken)
  • (future) any test that needs alphabetical Employee ordering

Fix Options

  • FE: send sort=firstName (or lastName) — match what BE supports
  • BE: accept name as alias mapped to concatenated full-name sort
  • Either way: FE should surface API errors instead of silently rendering empty

P1 Bug — Sort by Employee column completely brokenFE click handler sends sort=name. BE returns HTTP 400 with explicit message: "'name' is not a known sort key. Allowed: hireDate, firstName, lastName, dateCreated, dateModified." FE silently shows empty table; no error surfaced to user.

Fix Options

  • FE: send sort=firstName (or lastName) — match what BE supports
  • BE: accept name as alias mapped to concatenated full-name sort
  • Either way, FE should surface API errors instead of rendering empty table

Recommendations

  1. Seed fixture data via the BFF: create pending_invite, invited, invite_expired, probation rows so the remaining ~30 UI TCs can run.
  2. Provision MANAGER_USER in test-th-regional for negative-permission TCs.
  3. Confirm with PM: is the v1.1 decoupled-invite modal (spec §9.1) in scope for this build? If yes, TC-019/020/021/023+ should be reclassified FAIL. If no, the spec needs an explicit "deferred to v1.2" note.
  4. Pin naming convention — decide between snake_case (spec) and camelCase (current FE/BE) and align all three. P1 bug #6 (sort-by-name 400) is a direct consequence of this drift.
  5. File SNOPS bugs for the 12 identified defects, cross-linked to SN-69 and the corresponding WF-T-§§-NN test IDs.
